detailZh: 伊萨克·哈德贾尔：红牛车手将在阿塞拜疆大奖赛重返赛场，此前因手腕受伤缺席三场比赛
伊萨克·哈德贾尔在体能训练中手腕受伤，夏季休赛后错过了前三场比赛；从周四起通过天空体育F1频道观看阿塞拜疆大奖赛每个环节的直播，正赛于周六中午12点举行
红牛车手伊萨克·哈德贾尔将在阿塞拜疆大奖赛重返赛场，此前因手腕受伤缺席了三场比赛。
哈德贾尔作为马克斯·维斯塔潘的队友，在自己的首个赛季中表现相当不错，但他在8月一级方程式夏季休赛期间进行体能训练时受伤，因此无法参加荷兰、意大利和西班牙的比赛。
这位21岁的法国车手将在周四巴库的两节练习赛中重返驾驶舱，本周的赛程提前了一天，以避免与阿塞拜疆悼念日冲突。

红牛补充道：“车队衷心感谢利亚姆在过去三场比赛中展现出的职业精神、奉献精神和辛勤努力。”

哈德贾尔在红牛车队的首个赛季表现出色，直到遭遇伤病为止，他还在摩纳哥为车队登上过领奖台。
他目前仍然排在车手积分榜第八位，但在他受伤时落后迈凯伦车队的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里23分的差距，如今已经扩大到49分。
伊萨克·哈贾尔告诉卡伦·钱多克，他对自己在红牛与维斯塔潘搭档的表现感到满意。
在匈牙利站夏季休赛期前的最后一场比赛结束后，哈贾尔落后维斯塔潘 38 分，但现在已经落后这位荷兰车手 74 分。

detailEn: Isack Hadjar: Red Bull driver to return to action at Azerbaijan GP after missing three races with wrist injury

Isack Hadjar missed the first three races following the summer break after sustaining a wrist injury while doing fitness training; watch every session of the Azerbaijan GP from Thursday live on Sky Sports F1, with the race on Saturday at 12pm
Red Bull driver Isack Hadjar will return to action at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix after missing three races with a wrist injury.

Hadjar, who has fared reasonably well in his first season as Max Verstappen's team-mate, was unable to drive at races in the Netherlands, Italy and Spain after sustaining the injury while doing fitness training during Formula 1's summer break in August.

The 21-year-old Frenchman's return to the cockpit will come during Thursday's two practice sessions in Baku, with this weekend's schedule moved a day earlier to avoid a clash with Azerbaijan Remembrance Day.

A team statement released on Tuesday morning said: "Oracle Red Bull Racing is delighted to welcome Isack back this weekend.
"Having made a successful recovery from his wrist injury, Isack will return to action at the Baku City Circuit on Thursday."
Welcome back, Isack 💙#F1 || #RedBullRacing pic.twitter.com/6p1GzTsKyg
— Oracle Red Bull Racing (@redbullracing) September 22, 2026

Liam Lawson was promoted from Racing Bulls to deputise for Hadjar, with reserve driver Yuki Tsunoda filling the New Zealander's seat at Red Bull's junior squad.
Red Bull added: "The team would like to sincerely thank Liam for his professionalism, dedication and hard work over the past three races.

"Stepping in under challenging circumstances, he delivered some impressive performances and made a valuable contribution to the team. We wish him all the very best as he returns to Visa Cash App Racing Bulls."
Sky Sports' Craig Slater revealed further details on the extent of Isack Hadjar's wrist injury when it was first confirmed.
Racing Bulls also thanked Tsunoda for his contribution, with the Japanese driver now returning to his role as reserve for both teams.
"Liam returns to VCARB this weekend in Baku, with Isack having made a full recovery from his wrist injury," Racing Bulls said.
"A huge thank you to Yuki for stepping in over the past three races, giving everything for the team and scoring some very valuable points."

Hadjar had delivered a solid first campaign with Red Bull up until suffering the injury, claiming a podium for the team in Monaco.
He remains eighth in the Drivers' Championship but a 23-point deficit to McLaren's Oscar Piastri at the time of his injury has increased to 49 points.
Isack Hadjar tells Karun Chandhok he's pleased with how he's performed alongside Max Verstappen at Red Bull.
Hadjar was trailing Verstappen by 38 points after the final race before the summer break in Hungary but is now 74 points back from the Dutchman.
The Azerbaijan Grand Prix is the first round of a triple header with races in Malaysia and Singapore following on the subsequent two weekends.

detailEn: United States GP: Lewis Hamilton fastest from Max Verstappen in final practice ahead of Qualifying in Austin

Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton outpaced Red Bull's Max Verstappen in final practice in Austin with Friday's pace-setter Charles Leclerc in third; watch every United States GP session live on Sky Sports F1, with qualifying at 10pm on Saturday and the race at 8pm on Sunday
Lewis Hamilton claims the fastest lap from Max Verstappen in final practice at the United States Grand Prix
Lewis Hamilton topped final practice from Max Verstappen at the United States Grand Prix to set up a tantalising qualifying in Austin.
Hamilton was 0.168s quicker than Verstappen as Ferrari and Red Bull look set to fight for pole position and victory for a second consecutive weekend.
Charles Leclerc topped both of Friday's sessions and had set the quickest time in final practice by one tenth from Hamilton, only for it to be deleted due to track limits.

Track limits is set to be a major issue for the drivers in qualifying, which takes place at 10pm UK time later on Saturday (build-up from 8.30pm live on Sky Sports F1 and Main Event) due to the tarmac run-off areas and the drivers keen to use every bit of track to gain lap time.

Leclerc still finished the session in third, ahead of championship leader Kimi Antonelli whose chances of becoming the youngest world champion look extremely difficult, given he must first win the Grand Prix to give himself an opportunity, and Mercedes are a tad off the pace.
Antonelli was three tenths behind Hamilton's pace-setting time with his Mercedes team-mate George Russell in fifth at nearly half a second down.

McLaren's Lando Norris was eighth but would have been in the top five had his best lap not been deleted for track limit, while Oscar Piastri was sixth and Audi's Nico Hulkenberg impressing in seventh.
